posts.title: A Private Repo, a Public Mirror: Keeping AI Agent Conversations Out of Your Open Source Project
posts.description: AI coding agents are most useful when you talk to them like a teammate. You paste in the half-baked idea, the customer complaint, the “I’m not sure this design is right” doubt.
